title: The Manager (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational absurdist 106bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal football management comedy
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The manager stands in the technical area
Which is a rectangle of turf
That represents the precise limits
Of what a manager can actually do
Once the whistle goes

[Verse 2]
The manager had a plan
The plan was excellent
The plan accounted for most things
It did not account for the left back
Having a completely different plan
From the moment play began

[Chorus]
The manager says — this is what we trained for
The manager says — stick to the shape
The manager says — second ball, second ball
The players say — yes gaffer
And then do what the game requires
Which is frequently not the shape

[Bridge]
Chas said — the manager is the most optimistic person in football
They believe, at the start of every season
That this time the players will do
Exactly what was discussed in training
Chas said — this has never happened once in the history of the game
But the manager keeps believing

[Verse 3]
At full time the manager either embraced the assistant
Or stared at the middle distance
Both expressions mean the same thing
The plan met reality
And one of them blinked

[Outro]
The manager
The manager
That's my boy
